description: This file defines the SensorGauge class, which provides UI components to display sensor data as gauges, handle user interactions such as double-clicks and right-clicks, and manage gauge creation and updates within a Java Swing application.

classes.name: SensorGauge
classes.description: A utility class for creating and managing sensor gauges within a Swing UI, including interactions and gauge updates.

classes.name: SensorGauge.GaugeChangeListener
classes.description: Interface for listening to changes in the sensor displayed by a gauge, allowing dynamic gauge type switching.

methods.name: createGauge
methods.description: Creates a gauge component for a given sensor with an optional extra menu item and a change listener.

methods.name: createGaugeBody
methods.description: Constructs the main visual representation of the gauge, links it to sensor data, and sets interaction events.

methods.name: showPopupMenu
methods.description: Displays a right-click context menu to change gauge settings or switch sensors.

methods.name: fillGaugeMenuItems
methods.description: Populates the context menu with sensor categories and specific sensors, allowing user selection.

methods.name: handleDoubleClick
methods.description: Handles double-click events on the gauge to create a detachable view of the sensor.

methods.name: createRadial
methods.description: Constructs a radial gauge with specified title, units, max and min values.
